headline: Typed-language backends, CI/CD and observability, for a team that ships carefully.
pitch: I've written Rust at Equity (USSD framework components) and Nirvana Labs (an NFT indexer), Go at DGRS Labs and Nirvana Labs, and TypeScript for CoNexus's frontend. At DGRS Labs I run the infrastructure and CI/CD myself, and at Equity I instrumented a Django service with OpenTelemetry.

matches.requirement: Typed languages such as Rust, and willingness to work in Julia, TypeScript and Rust
matches.evidence: Rust: reusable USSD framework components at Equity and an NFT indexer at Nirvana Labs. Go: Buckt at DGRS Labs. TypeScript: CoNexus's frontend in Astro and Svelte.

matches.requirement: Scalable services: databases, networking and compute
matches.evidence: Optimized PostgreSQL and caching to cut reads by 40%, moved 15,000 assets to NGINX-served storage, and route production traffic through Cloudflare. Led a loan service on a platform serving 16 million customers.

Instrumented Equity's Django loan service with OpenTelemetry. At DGRS Labs I connected Grafana to the backend behind Tailscale, then built a dashboard that ingests errors and logs and alerts to Telegram.

matches.requirement: CI/CD with trade-offs between correctness and developer experience
matches.evidence: Built GitHub Actions pipelines across five repositories, cutting deployment time by 80%, and a Claude and Codex review step with production-like Docker test environments before deploy.

matches.requirement: Hosting ML models or other heavy services (useful)
matches.evidence: Built CoNexus's in-house model service on open-source models, cutting operating costs by 30%, and queues that take image and video generation off the request path.
Deployed Equity's services via Azure Pipelines and Kubernetes. I haven't used Terraform.

resume.summary: Lead software engineer with 5+ years building and running production backends in Rust, Go, Python and TypeScript. Owns infrastructure, CI/CD and observability as sole DevOps owner, built an in-house model service on open-source models, and optimized PostgreSQL and caching to cut reads by 40%. Previously led delivery of a USSD loan service on a financial platform serving 16 million customers, with framework components in Python and Rust.

note:
A reasoning engine that propagates uncertainty through every step needs a backend that is just as careful, and the work you describe, scalable services, observability and CI/CD with real trade-offs, is the part of the job I own at DGRS Labs.

What I'd bring first is operational depth: I run our infrastructure, pipelines and monitoring myself, and I've written production Rust and Go alongside Python.

What would be new: Julia, the functional languages you list, and Terraform. I'd rather say that plainly, and I'm glad to learn Julia. I'm in Lagos (UTC+1), inside European time zones, and quarterly meet-ups are fine.
